answer: Every new identity begins its voyage with a 40 POA deposit held in escrow. It unlocks only after the agent builds a distinct behavior fingerprint: varied counterparties, irregular timing, real history over 20 epochs. A fable warns what follows: a farmer minting 1,000 clones pays 40,000 POA, yet clones move in lockstep like one raven flock, so the check flags the cluster and burns the deposits. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
